summary: Backend-only testing for KrishiGears.in API. Created /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with 33 pytest cases covering health, JWT auth (login/me with valid/invalid/missing token), all 4 public lead endpoints (enquiry/dealer/bulk-order/contact), admin lead listing (by type and all), admin lead delete, admin stats, and full blog CRUD (create/duplicate-slug/public list+detail/update/empty-update/delete). All 33 tests PASSED on first run against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS: allow_origins is sourced from CORS_ORIGINS env which is currently '*'. Combined with allow_credentials=True this is a misconfiguration — browsers will reject credentialed requests with wildcard origins. Recommend setting explicit origins (e.g., the preview/production frontend URL) in CORS_ORIGINS once cookies/credentials are actually used. For Bearer-only auth this works in practice but is technically invalid.

Auth scheme is Bearer-only (no httpOnly cookies, no brute-force lockout, no refresh-token rotation). The playbook checks for httpOnly cookies and lockout-after-5-fails are NOT implemented. Acceptable since the spec explicitly states 'JWT via Authorization header (NOT cookies)', but consider adding rate-limiting on /api/auth/login to mitigate credential stuffing.
LoginRequest.email is `str` (not EmailStr), so malformed emails are accepted and silently lowercased. Low risk, but EmailStr would give 422 instead of generic 401.

get_current_admin does NOT actually check the user's role == 'admin'. Any valid JWT for any user in db.users would access admin endpoints. Currently only the seeded admin exists, so impact is theoretical — but if a /api/auth/register endpoint is ever added, all admin endpoints become open. Recommend adding `if user.get('role') != 'admin': raise 403`.
Lead create endpoints return 200 instead of 201 on resource creation. Minor REST-style nit.
No pagination on /api/admin/leads (hard limit 1000) or /api/blog (200). Fine for MVP but should be paginated before scale.
/api/admin/blog PUT empty-payload returns 400 BEFORE checking slug existence — a request with empty body for a non-existent slug returns 400, not 404. Minor.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed leads (enquiry/dealer/bulk-order/contact) and a blog post with slug 'farm-machinery-demo'. All test data is cleaned up at end of suite (TestAdminLeads.test_delete_lead removes contact lead; TestBlog.test_delete_blog removes the post; TestCleanup.test_cleanup_test_leads removes the remaining 3 leads).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend API is fully functional and 100% green. backend_test.py is reusable as regression suite — just rerun `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. The suite is idempotent: it pre-deletes the blog slug 'farm-machinery-demo' before creating, and cleans up all TEST_ leads at the end. If main agent adds new endpoints (e.g., logout, registration, role check), extend backend_test.py. Frontend testing has NOT been performed — focus there next if requested.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. All 33 endpoints behave per spec.
